title: Auna Announces Reporting Dates for First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
summary: Auna S.A. (NYSE: AUNA) (“Auna” or “the Company”), a leading Latin American healthcare services and plan provider with operations in Mexico, Peru and Colombia, announced today the reporting dates for its First Quarter 2026 financial results. Our mission is to transform healthcare by providing access to a highly integrated healthcare offering in the underpenetrated markets of Spanish-speaking Americas.
